name: H3 whole block-stack residual cache (DaSiWa)
plain: Skips all H3 transformer blocks at once on some steps and adds the block stack's last residual to the current input instead. The decision compares a thin sample of the stack's input between steps, so no block has to run to decide. It needs a replaced model forward, because core has no patch point around the whole block loop.
math:
sig(h) = mean over the first 64 hidden dims of |h|, taken on about 100 evenly spaced rows of each audio and video segment (text excluded).
On each eval with a cached residual: A += mean|sig(h) − sig_last| / (mean|sig_last| + 1e-6), where sig_last is from the last computed eval and stays fixed across skips.
Skip when start_percent ≤ step/total ≤ end_percent, A < reuse_threshold, consecutive skips < max_steps: h_out = h + R.
Otherwise run blocks, R = h_out − h, A = 0.
Progress is a step fraction (counted on timestep change), not a sigma percent.

props.hook: add_object_patch diffusion_model._forward + set_model_patch_replace(dit, block_loop, 0) + OUTER_SAMPLE wrapper
props.architectures: MiniMaxH3Model only; raises on any other class name

surprise: The first pass filed this pack under first-block-cache, but it runs no block to decide; the signal is the stack's input. It also holds a full copy of core's H3 _forward, so core changes to that function do not reach it.
